profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Equal parts coffee, wine, and Taylor Swift gifs. Often the loudest person in the room.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, documented, developed, tested, and deployed new customer behavior analytics for flagship product CreditWise per Product requirements.
•	Designed, architected, and led cross team stakeholder meetings for a multi domain transaction flow system processing 300,000 deposits/week across front end, middleware, and external vendor integration.
•	Managed multiple upgrades to databases, external vendor products(ArcGIS, TransactionMiddleware), and other AWS resources as needed to meet security guidelines and keep applications resilient.
•	Implemented move from vendor product to in house application for all ATM screens (NodeJS, React, Java, RESTful APIs).
•	Collaborated with Product and Tech leaders to lead microservice feature development (NodeJS, Javascript, Java, React), including prototyping withdrawal limit feature and dynamic ATM ad placements.
•	Updated current processes by developing large scale, real time analytics pipelines in AWS using Kinesis, Lambda, Snowflake/OneLake/Splunk to  improve observability and decision making on the ATMs.
•	Independently evaluated and implemented proof of concept machine learning based anomaly detection and regression models (Python, scikit‑learn, Snowflake) for business intelligence insights.
•	On call rotations to monitor and resolve production issues as needed, applied blameless post mortems and reliability best practices. Ensured ~2000 ATMs were operational at any given time. 
•	Implemented DevOps improvements for CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), infrastructure automation (CloudFormation), and participated in quarterly chaos engineering experiments.
•	Mentored junior employees and trained multiple teams on SME areas - Snowflake, Databricks, Splunk, VM ATM testing flow, team norms, culture, communication, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Participated in design, development, monitoring, and support of scalable microservices using Java, Scala, and AWS technologies in support of high volume customer facing systems.
•	Led migration of multiple microservice databases from Cassandra to DynamoDB and Aurora, in one case resulting in 10x reduction in monthly database hosting costs.

positions.title: Maximo Consultant
positions.description:
•	Develop, implement, and maintain BIRT reports for Maximo and IBM SmartCloud Control Desk using Eclipse IDE. Mainly comprised of JavaScript and SQL. Display data in an aesthetically pleasing manner, read and insert into tables from files, support month end financial processes, and train coworkers in similar tasks. 
•	Create, implement, and maintain rules and scripts using TRM RulesManager scripting engine. Involves JavaScript as well as SQL. Implement new business processes and data migration using scripts.
•	Build and maintain multiple integration interfaces using interface tables, web services, and scripts.
•	Develop resolutions to customer problems, prepare test scripts, and create/modify documentation as needed.

positions.title: Junior Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Resolved customer problems providing support and solutions.
•	Developed front end customization of Maximo applications and implementation of company business practices.
•	Prepared test scripts and participated in testing of different Maximo applications.
•	Contributed to development and maintenance of training documentation as well as participated in training for TRM and clients.
